answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate our models via automatic evaluation metrics using ROUGE , as well as human evaluations

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on Amazon MTurk to analyze the effect of adding graph input to the BART-Long model
answer_4.guideline: We give the following guidelines on deciding which summary is more informative or more coherent, respectively: • Informativeness: The more informative summary is better at expressing the main points of the news story. It contains information that is more relevant and important. It has fewer unimportant details. Its content is more similar to the human-written summary. • Coherence: The more coherent summary has better structure and flow, is easier to follow. The facts are presented in a more logical order.
